name: Overfrequency protection
summary: Supervises frequency above the defined operating criterion.
description: Supervises frequency above the defined operating criterion.

The drafting record should connect this function to the frequency measurement source and enabled overfrequency stage, then trace the generator or interconnection overfrequency output. Keep the complete designation and equipment tag together so that the SLD, relay logic and terminal schedule describe the same implementation.

The cited mapping is a public manufacturer example (Eaton E-Series function mapping). Suffixes are not universal equivalences across products, and this reference supplies neither a protection setting nor certification of the selected scheme.
readingNotes: Identify the frequency measurement source and enabled overfrequency stage.
Trace the generator or interconnection overfrequency output.
drawingChecklist: Label the frequency measurement source and enabled overfrequency stage.
Cross-reference the generator or interconnection overfrequency output.
Retain the complete suffix, selected device tag and manufacturer manual revision.
distinction: The suffix O is the letter O for overfrequency; use the complete label to avoid confusion with a zero in search or drawing text.
